tag.description: The HTML tag for the div block container. One of: div, header, section, article, aside, footer, main, nav, a (link), or button. Do not use heading or paragraph tags.

settings.description: Tag settings matching the chosen tag's schema in the resource.

anyOf.description: Bind THIS value to a dynamic tag instead of a static value (this may be a nested field, e.g. an image's "src"). Look up the chosen tag in the "elementor://dynamic-tags" resource and populate "settings" exactly as its schema requires.

llm_guidance.instructions: These are the default styles applied to the widget. Override only when necessary.
